ports.name: Mumbai (Jawaharlal Nehru)
ports.notes: Harit Sagar green port initiative; OPS commissioning targeted 2027.

ports.name: Singapore
ports.notes: MPA green port program; OPS at Tuas and Pasir Panjang terminals.

ports.name: Fujairah
ports.notes: World's second largest bunkering hub. No OPS infrastructure.

ports.name: Yokohama
ports.notes: Carbon neutral port program; OPS at Daikoku and Honmoku piers.

ports.name: Colombo
ports.notes: South Asia transshipment hub. OPS under feasibility study.

ports.name: Mundra
ports.notes: India's largest commercial port. Adani green energy tie-in lowers effective grid CI.

ports.name: Chennai
ports.notes: Major east coast port under Sagarmala modernisation.

ports.name: Visakhapatnam
ports.notes: Deepest port on India's east coast; bulk and general cargo.
